description: This source file defines the FirmwareFlasher class responsible for flashing firmware onto a device via a graphical user interface. It manages user interactions, executes external commands to flash firmware, and displays status messages.

classes.name: FirmwareFlasher
classes.description: A GUI component for flashing firmware onto a device, extending ProcessStatusWindow, encapsulating user interactions, command execution, and flash process management.

methods.name: FirmwareFlasher
methods.description: Constructor initializing the flashing button and its action listener, prompting user confirmation and initiating firmware flashing.

methods.name: getOpenocdCommad
methods.description: Constructs and returns the command string to invoke OpenOCD with the appropriate configuration for flashing.

methods.name: doFlashFirmware
methods.description: Performs the firmware flashing process by checking file existence, executing the command, and displaying success or error messages.

methods.name: getButton
methods.description: Returns the JButton component associated with this firmware flasher.
